answer: Web-of-trust depth scoring at the ripple: each new identity must be attested by two existing members, and trust propagates only 3 hops. The trellis caps verified reach, so a farm's fake accounts cluster at low depth. Each attestation costs one staked bond, and an echo of a rejected attestation slashes the voucher 50%. A 100-identity farm burns ~200 bonds and still scores below depth-4 honest nodes. Conclusion: linear cost per identity versus sublinear trust gain makes farming unprofitable.
